content: Khri Zisu rai rawng tei thong a tlahpaw kama Paul le kaa unypaw Timote tah kaa dopaw vesaw le rai kaa hrehruipaw a cangpaw Filemon,
kaa sateino Afia, Zisu Khri letah raekeh rai kaa hrehruipaw Arkhipa le na ing letei a pungpaw he khrisawbu khatah ca kaa ca kua he.
Kaa Paw Khazing le Abuipaw Zisu Khri taiteipaw ningdonah le thlawlungnah cawh naaning khatah ung ky seh.
Lawngbia hlainah le thlawchangnah
Ka thlawchangnah letah a ca thui neh ka, ka Khazing cawh ka lawng paria thlang,
zecawtamaw tatah Abuipaw Zisu letei angepainah na hnuipaw le mehpathai vytei na donah pawhe kong ka thui cawtah a cang.
Na zingnah khah cawngsaw hringpaw ching pachaw hrá pawtah thlaw ka chang tei, ma pawsui co, Khri letei kaa hnuipaw hming chawpaw vytei hnithainah khah na hnui khy a.
Donah na hnuinahpaw takhei lunglawngnah alaipaw pui le thawzaang a pa peh, zecawtamaw tatah nama unypaw tah mehpathai sahlo aa lungthing thaw khah na thosah he.
Onesima caw tei Paul tah nawpawnah
Khri thongtah na tua ruapaw khah tua law tatah raechá tah bia a ca pei khypaw ka cang thlang naná teitah,
donah na hnuinah caw takhei, a naw tah ka ca naw hri hi. Mataico macang a cangpaw le ato zong heh Khri Zisu rawng tei thong a tlahpaw kama Paul tah,
bahrairui khi ka cangning tei ka sawcapaw a cangpaw Onesima cawtah hei ka ca nawpaw a cang.
Akhung ciapaw cai leco ama cawh na cawtah sangtle bingbi be, canghrasala atoheh cawh nama le kama kaa cawtah sang a tle myca.
Kama ka lungthing vytei tei ka dopaw nama khatah ka va seisah kaw hi.
Thawngchawbia rawng tei bahrairui ka khi chung lehei nama caipaw tei rai a pa bong rua pawtah kama khatah ungsah paria ka du thlang.
Canghrasala, nama na rei ly co zehming hmai tua du bei neh, ma pawsui co ma chahnah na tuapaw cawh hneh chaipaw hratah cang lytah nama na lungtho tei tuapaw a cang a.
Cai a cawngpe a ca lysainah pawhe heh naa hnui the kaw khy nápaw a cang khy thlang thly a;
sae hratah cang khawh lytah sae navy tah achaw vypaw, uny dopaw hratah na hnui a. Kama taco do ngetei neh ka, nama taco cawngsaw hratah le Abuipaw letei uny hratah na do vy chichi a.
Macawtaco vesaw huikong hmuisui tei na parawh caco, kama na pa cyhlangpaw hratah ama heh cyhlang hrah my lo.
Na cung letah hmingsua a tua le khahlui a hnui caco, kama ka khahlui tah rawh thlang my lo.
Kama, Paul tah ma ca heh kama ka kih ceingei tah ka cia hi. Kama tah ka ca chang tae a. Kama ka cung letah nama hrahring tah hringnah luibah na hnuipaw khah ka rei dupaw cang be.
Unypaw, sadu ka thawpaw cawh Abuipaw lehei nama taitah chahnainah hmuh neh seh tahpaw heh a cang; Khri letah ka lungthaw pa dangsah my lo.
Rei na nge a tahpaw zing neh ka, ka reipaw navy zong tah a hlu vy tah na tua a tahpaw hni hmotah nama kha ca ka va ciapaw a cang hi.
Taico a hiapaw ahringpaw hming sangkheh cawh ka tlung nápaw za tingtua my lo, zecawtamaw tatah naa thlawchangnah hlo tling sá pawtah ka va ca tlong khy kaw he tah ka hnabei a sui.
Khri Zisu rawng tei thong ka tlah hruipaw Epafra tah a dang pawtah a ca tah he.
Taico rai ka hrehruipaw Marka, Aristarka, Dema le Luka zong tah a dang pawtah aa ca tah hrah he.
Abuipaw Zisu Khri ningdonah cawh na thlawpaw khatah ung ky seh.
